paraphrase: Rajjab, riding to his wedding in the groom's crown, met Dādū, heard one word and turned back; he wore the wedding crown all his life as the bridegroom of the Lord.
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
